title: Investigate running-response limits and allow five shared Buddy executions
summary: The thread establishes that foreground replies in separate channel threads were not globally capped at the time of initial investigation; per-thread turns serialize, while background work had separate per-Buddy and workspace caps. The follow-up task implements one FIFO pool of five per Buddy shared across foreground/channel and background execution, adds queued UI state and an integration test, and reports updating 61 live memberships from 2 to 5 with owner approval. The Unleashd integration commits e99e59c, 4ae9385 and 24d60c7 are ancestors of current main. The task remains in review because its documented live runtime check was not done: the backend had not reloaded and no live sixth-reply queued-and-landed behavior was confirmed. Thus implementation, tests and integration are evidenced; release/runtime activation is not fully verified.
nextAction: Buddies Development Lead should coordinate with Release Engineer to confirm the production/dev backend is running the integrated code, then verify that a sixth concurrent reply for one Buddy is visibly queued and eventually lands; attach evidence and close/update the existing task. Resolve or explicitly record the task's workspace-wide cap question if still applicable.
